Second alpha of **Nexo**. It adds push to talk, per-friend volume, profile pictures, a system tray mode,
and **automatic updates**.

> **Coming from v0.1.0-alpha.1?** That version can't update itself. Download and install this one by
> hand **once**. Your name and settings are kept. After that, Nexo updates itself.

## What's new

- **Automatic updates.** Nexo checks for new versions in the background. When one is downloaded, a banner
  offers **Restart to update**. If you ignore it, the update installs the next time you quit. Nexo never
  restarts by itself, and the button warns you if it would drop you out of a voice call. You can also go to
  **Settings → App → Updates**. On macOS, Nexo tells you when an update is available and links to the
  download.
- **Push to talk.** In **Settings → Audio & video → Input mode**, record any key or mouse button (side
  buttons work great). It works while a game has focus. A short release delay keeps the ends of words. On
  macOS, allow Nexo in **Privacy & Security → Accessibility**.
- **Friend volume.** Right-click a friend in a voice channel to set their volume (0–200%) or **Mute for
  me**. It only affects what you hear.
- **Profile pictures.** In **Settings → Profile → Upload picture**, crop the image and you're done.
  Everyone sees it right away.
- **System tray.** The close button now hides Nexo to the tray, so you stay in voice. The tray menu has
  Open, Mute, Deafen, Leave voice and Quit. You can turn this off in **Settings → App**.

**Hosts:** profile pictures need the updated server. On the host, run `git pull`, then restart the Nexo
server.

## Install

Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below. The installers are **not code-signed**, so
your OS will warn you the first time.

- **Windows:** run `Nexo-Setup-<version>.exe`. If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click
  **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag Nexo to **Applications**. The first time, **right-click Nexo →
  Open → Open**. If macOS says the app "is damaged", run `xattr -cr /Applications/Nexo.app` in Terminal.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Nexo-*.AppImage && ./Nexo-*.AppImage`. Auto-update works for the AppImage.

The `latest*.yml` and `.blockmap` files are used by the auto-updater. You don't need to download them.

## Known limitations

- **Stream audio echo (Windows):** system audio capture includes Nexo's own voice playback. Set Nexo's
  **speaker** (Settings → Audio & video) to a different device than the one the game plays on.
- **Linux:** no system audio capture for streams yet. On Wayland, push to talk only works while Nexo is
  focused.
- **macOS** can't auto-install updates until the app is signed with a Developer ID. It shows a Download
  link instead.
- Nexo is only available while the host PC is on.
